title: Kissed Creamy Vietnamese Pork Banh Mi
description: A floral and creamy Vietnamese dish featuring cloves and pork, served on a wooden board in the form of a banh mi, this recipe is a romantic twist on traditional Vietnamese cuisine, with a low-calorie friendly air-fry method.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the ground cloves and mayonnaise until well combined.
Add the sliced pork shoulder to the bowl and toss to coat with the clove mayonnaise mixture.
Air-fry the pork for 10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the baguette by slicing it in half and placing it in the air fryer for 2 minutes.
Assemble the banh mi by spreading a layer of the clove mayonnaise mixture on the bottom half of the baguette.
Add a layer of pickled carrots and daikon on top of the mayonnaise.
Add a layer of cooked pork on top of the pickled vegetables.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro on top of the pork.
Drizzle with fish sauce and sriracha, if using.
Top with the top half of the baguette and serve on a wooden board.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
